newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gilead Sciences a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gilead Sciences a buy.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International on Wednesday initiated coverage of Gilead Sciences Inc with a buy rating, citing the recent approval of the company's antiviral drug VISTIDE in two major geographic markets.

-- Vector analyst Michael King said Gilead has one of the deepest and strongest product pipelines in the biotechnology industry, in addition to the financial and pipeline resources to send the company to the top tier among its competitors.

-- Gilead has several upcoming milestones that could move its shares significantly, King said. These include presentation of data on an oral drug to treat HIV infection in Washington, DC, this month, and continuing oral trials of a drug to treat hepatitis B.
-- Gilead develops injectable and oral antiviral drugs.
-- Its shares were trading down 1/8 Wednesday at 26-7/8.
